take: Anaheim announced it recalled forward Roger McQueen from San Diego (AHL), activated defenseman Drew Helleson from injured reserve and placed forward Ryan Poehling on injured reserve. Poehling's absence matters: the Ducks were better with him on the ice, and Leo Carlsson, Nikita Klepov and Judd Caulfield have absorbed his minutes over the last three games. McQueen, who has no points in three games, was at 34% of the 5-on-5 chance quality, so Mikael Granlund is next in line for his minutes. Helleson's return should settle the second pair.
